# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- When documenting project status, separate hardware limitations owned by the head developer from software conditions, software problems, and software improvements. The Canon EOS 60D red recording indicator is a known camera overlay that can be falsely selected as the strongest red LED candidate; do not describe the red DualShock LED as the root problem.
- Select cursor-position debug as a camera input type through the app's interactive selection, not by launching the app with command-line arguments.
